"""Qualify the exact cold-deployment patch, separate from stale development trees."""

from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v25-followup-20261011")
ENGINE = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v267-host-reclaim-engine-20261013")
MAIN = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/BeliefKV")
PATCH = ROOT / "patches/sglang-v0.5.20-beliefkv-staging.patch"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v268_host_reclaim_qualification_20261013.json"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from beliefkv.experiments.source_provenance import git_source_state
from scripts.resume_predictive_after_native import engine_delta
from scripts.summarize_semantic_h2d_ab import verify_frozen_execution_source

if OUTPUT.exists():
    raise ValueError("preserve prior evidence")
started = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
environment = {
    **os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": f"{ENGINE / 'python'}:{ROOT}", "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "",
}
baseline_check = """
import ast, subprocess
from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components import full
import pytest
src = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_cache/components/full.py'], text=True)
cls = next(n for n in ast.parse(src).body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'FullComponent')
fn = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'drive_host_eviction')
unit = ast.Module(body=[ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__', names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')], level=0), fn], type_ignores=[])
ns = dict(vars(full))
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(unit), '<upstream-full-eviction>', 'exec'), ns)
full.FullComponent.drive_host_eviction = ns['drive_host_eviction']
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-q','test/srt/test_beliefkv_full_host_eviction.py',
                            '-k','satisfied_duplicate','--tb=short']))
"""
before = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-c", baseline_check], cwd=ENGINE, env=environment,
    text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=60,
)
if before.returncode != 1 or "3 failed, 2 deselected" not in before.stdout:
    raise ValueError("original implementation did not reproduce all three regressions")
command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q",
           str(ENGINE / "test/srt/test_beliefkv_full_host_eviction.py"),
           str(ENGINE / "test/srt/test_beliefkv_host_eviction_observer.py"),
           "tests/test_v0520_native_telemetry.py"]
after = subprocess.run(
    command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=60,
)
if after.returncode or "113 passed" not in after.stdout:
    print(after.stdout)
    raise ValueError("candidate qualification failed")
engine = git_source_state(ENGINE, canonical_patch=PATCH)["canonical_patch"]
subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--reverse", "--check", str(PATCH)], cwd=ENGINE, check=True)
delta = engine_delta(
    ENGINE, MAIN / "patches/sglang-v0.5.20-beliefkv-staging.patch", PATCH,
)
delta_files = [line for line in delta.decode().splitlines() if line.startswith("diff --git ")]
if len(delta_files) != 2 or not all(
    any(path in line for path in ("components/full.py", "test_beliefkv_full_host_eviction.py"))
    for line in delta_files
):
    raise ValueError("unexpected engine deployment scope")
paths = [
    "patches/sglang-v0.5.20-beliefkv-staging.patch",
    "beliefkv/runtime/v0520_native_telemetry.py",
    "tests/test_v0520_native_telemetry.py",
]
report = {
    "schema_version": 1, "started_at_local": started,
    "completed_at_local": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    "qualified_engine": str(ENGINE), "engine": engine,
    "main_execution_verification": verify_frozen_execution_source(
        MAIN, "69beb35cdb7eafa6e6c8399bff4484222ec8c189",
    ),
    "baseline_regression_returncode": before.returncode,
    "baseline_regression_output": before.stdout,
    "qualification_command": command, "qualification_output": after.stdout,
    "qualification_returncode": after.returncode, "passed": 113,
    "engine_delta_files": delta_files,
    "engine_delta_sha256": hashlib.sha256(delta).hexdigest(),
    "qualified_paths_sha256": {
        path: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths
    },
    "scope": (
        "Stop scanning only when earlier duplicate reclamation already satisfies FULL capacity. "
        "Necessary native eviction order, locks, frees, H2D dependencies and policy remain. "
        "Four integer counters are copied into the existing once-per-second Host sample."
    ),
    "limits": [
        "Existing followup engine was older than the canonical patch in five files. "
        "Preserved it and rebuilt a new isolated engine from the complete current patch.",
        "These CPU/telemetry checks and microbenchmarks do not establish GPU/JCT benefit.",
        "This is a shared native-path optimization. Historical V29 native remains a "
        "development reference, not a same-version evaluation of this patch.",
    ],
    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "helper_utf8_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({
    "output": str(OUTPUT), "passed": 113,
    "original_regressions_reproduced": 3, "engine": engine,
}, indent=2))
